label: Opening Slice Gold Candidate
goldPurpose: Confirm the first playable minute is understandable, stable, controller-playable, and readable with debug hidden before widening into the Grave memory route.
goldCandidateSystems: Host Core boot and local-cell loading
cinematic awakening cues without control lockout
Signal Chorus arrival and interaction loop
mustPass: Boot starts cleanly with no startup validation error.
Debug starts hidden by default and F1/F2/F3 can still reveal it.
Player can understand the first action without debug panels.
Safe seed can be targeted and absorbed.
Scar contamination reads as unsafe and resists forced absorb.
First tissue fold happens as a no-gate morph.
Second tissue fold reaches Signal Chorus as a no-gate morph.
Signal Chorus loop can complete the required first playable minute.
Controller can complete the required opening chain.
Right-stick/IJKL camera control keeps the core visible.
No console crash occurs through the required opening chain.
mustNotRegress: No gates, doors, teleports, hard exits, stage-node transitions, or old chamber runtime return.
Debug panels remain build tools rather than final HUD.
Visuals remain recipe-driven and placeholder contracts remain enforceable.
Bloom Residue Fork remains optional for the first playable minute.
Route planning remains data-only until HC-004.
nextIfFails: HC-003NA Opening Gold Candidate Fix Pass
